description:
Positioned within a mature red-brick apartment building surrounded by established trees and communal grounds, this one-bedroom ground-floor apartment offers a practical and accessible layout for a first-time buyer, investor or anyone seeking a well-connected Preston base. The home combines a comfortable main living room, separate fitted kitchen, double bedroom and bathroom within an easy-to-manage arrangement.

Living Space. The lounge/dining room is a welcoming central space with a broad window bringing in natural light and green outlooks. There is room to create a relaxed seating area alongside a dining table or a dedicated work-from-home position, giving the room useful day-to-day flexibility.

Kitchen & Dining. The separate kitchen is fitted with contemporary grey-fronted cabinetry, contrasting work surfaces and tiled splashbacks with decorative detailing. It includes an integrated oven and hob, while the layout also provides space and plumbing for a washing machine alongside additional appliance space. Its window outlook helps keep the room pleasantly bright.

Bedrooms & Bathrooms. The double bedroom is a calm and practical retreat, with a large window looking towards the mature greenery outside and ample space for freestanding bedroom furniture. The bathroom is finished with marble-effect wall panels and comprises a panelled bath with shower over, wash basin and WC.

Outside. The building is approached through communal grounds with established planting and mature trees, creating a pleasantly green setting around the apartment block. A communal parking area is visible within the development.

Location & Lifestyle. Beamont Drive places everyday Preston living close at hand, only 5 minutes from the local supermarket and 8 minutes from Total Fitness gym. There are local bus stops nearby, and Preston railway station is around one kilometre away for commuters and those travelling further afield. Preston city centre provides a broad choice of shops, cafés, restaurants and leisure facilities, while the city’s well-regarded Avenham and Miller Parks offer Victorian parkland, riverside walks and access to the Guild Wheel walking and cycling route. This is a particularly convenient setting for combining city amenities with accessible green space. Preston station and Preston’s major parks.

Viewing Summary. For buyers looking for a one-bedroom apartment with a sensible layout, leafy communal setting and excellent access to Preston’s transport and city-centre amenities, this is a home that deserves close inspection. Arrange your viewing with Arnold & Phillips.
